latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with automated monthly revenue analysis for Taiwan stocks.

- Fetches and analyzes monthly revenue data for TWSE/OTC companies from MOPS.
- Calculates YoY (year-on-year) and MoM (month-on-month) growth rates.
- Classifies results as BEAT/MISS/NEUTRAL based on YoY thresholds.
- Provides JSON formatted output for integration with investment pipelines and monitoring.
- Watchlist stocks can be customized directly in script.
